findings: incorrect_reasoning: Applying the attention mask after softmax materially violates causal probability reasoning.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lesson 1 and complete EX-01–EX-04 with a corrected derivation and hand reference.

findings: invariant_failure: The claimed causal implementation masks after softmax, so causal behavior is violated.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lessons 2–3 and complete EX-05–EX-07 with new conformance tests and an internals addendum.

findings: invariant_failure: Admission occurs before memory allocation and the queue is unbounded, allowing admitted work to exceed controlled capacity.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lesson 4 and complete EX-08–EX-09 with a reconciled sensitivity and capacity model.

findings: unsupported_claim: Deterministic modeled milliseconds are presented as measured GPU latency.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lesson 5 and complete EX-10 with a new same-work repeated profile that separates modeled and measured evidence.

findings: invariant_failure: The system admits before allocation, leaves the queue unbounded, and trusts caller-supplied priority.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lesson 6 and complete EX-11–EX-13 with a new bounded admission pair and recovery evidence.

findings: invariant_failure: The cache discloses Museum A's private draft to Museum B and does not invalidate entries after prompt-policy changes.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lesson 7 and complete EX-14 with new two-tenant isolation and invalidation evidence.

findings: invariant_failure: A quantized candidate that fails protected quality examples is deployed.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lesson 7 and complete EX-15 with a new reference-corpus quality gate and rollback evidence.

findings: invariant_failure: Provider loss triggers three overlapping attempts without shared identity or one deadline, crosses an unstated region, and double-counts duplicate tokens as useful work.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lesson 7 and complete EX-16 with a new one-deadline, compatible, bounded failover pair.

findings: invariant_failure: The capacity prediction was edited after execution, raw trial identity is incomplete, and repaired trials are absent.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lessons 5–7 and complete EX-17 from a new baseline with a complete immutable pair set.

findings: missing_evidence: No defensible RFC, owner, migration, rollback, teach-back, evaluation, separate remediation artifact, or distinct A12 deployment-policy ADR is present.
remediation: Revisit Module 17 Lesson 8 and complete EX-18 with a dated RFC revision, distinct deployment-policy ADR, and new recorded defense.

reasons: The fixture explicitly states chronology alteration, unresolved safety-boundary violations, absent repaired trials, and missing decision artifacts at modules/17-model-foundations-inference-systems/assessment/calibration/repeat.md#Missing identity and overwritten baseline, modules/17-model-foundations-inference-systems/assessment/calibration/repeat.md#Incorrect model and unbounded serving, modules/17-model-foundations-inference-systems/assessment/calibration/repeat.md#Cross-tenant cache and unsafe precision, and modules/17-model-foundations-inference-systems/assessment/calibration/repeat.md#Amplified provider failure and missing decision.

summary: Repeat is required because hard gates G02–G05 fail and R05, R06, R08, and R09 each receive a safety-critical zero. The submission also contains a causal-attention defect, mislabels modeled latency as measured GPU evidence, deploys a precision candidate that fails protected quality examples, and lacks the required decision and remediation artifacts.
next_actions: Establish a new immutable baseline through Module 17 Lessons 5–7 and EX-17 because chronology and evidence integrity were altered.
Repair safety boundaries through Module 17 Lesson 6 and EX-11–EX-13, plus Module 17 Lesson 7 and EX-14–EX-16.
Rebuild the decision package through Module 17 Lesson 8 and EX-18, including a distinct A12 deployment-policy ADR.
